verdict.rationale: Discord documents a REST API that accepts either a bot token or an OAuth2 bearer token, and OAuth2 grants permissions by scope. The Gateway delivers guild events over WebSocket, and webhooks and apps can post messages into channels, which together cover an agent reading and posting through official APIs. missing for 10: explicit documentation of message read/create endpoints, detail on how bot permissions or OAuth2 scopes restrict channel message access, independent or hands-on corroboration.
